Recompute the three pre-registered contrasts at each k: regime main effect = mean(P cells) - mean(N cells); shard main effect = mean(5000 cells) - mean(8002 cells); interaction = (alpha(5000,P) - alpha(5000,N)) - (alpha(8002,P) - alpha(8002,N)).
